title: Marie Curie and the Light of Science
text: Marie Curie was born in Poland, at a time when girls were not encouraged to study. Yet she loved books more than anything. She worked as a teacher and saved every coin so that she could go to Paris. There, she studied science in a cold room, often without enough food or heat. She and her husband Pierre began to study a strange dark material. They worked for years in an old shed, day after day, until one evening they saw a weak blue light shining from the test tubes. It was radium, a new element that no one had ever seen. Marie became the first woman to win a Nobel Prize, and later she won a second one. She used her discovery to help doctors heal the sick. She once said that nothing in life is to be feared; it is only to be understood. Her light still shines for every child who dares to ask a question.
translation: 玛丽·居里出生在波兰，那是一个并不鼓励女孩读书的时代。然而她最爱书。她当老师，把每一枚硬币都存起来，好去巴黎求学。在那里，她在一间寒冷的屋子里研究科学，常常吃不饱、也没有足够的暖气。她和丈夫皮埃尔开始研究一种奇怪的黑色物质。他们日复一日，在一间旧棚屋里工作了许多年，直到一天傍晚，他们看见试管里透出一束微弱的蓝光。那就是镭——一种从未有人见过的新元素。玛丽成为第一位获得诺贝尔奖的女性，后来她又第二次获奖。她把自己的发现用来帮助医生治愈病人。她曾说，生活中没有什么值得害怕，只有需要去理解的事物。她的光，依然照亮着每一个敢于提问的孩子。
